title: XSR700 Heritage (Touring Pack)
description: Representing Yamaha's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Yamaha XSR700 Heritage (Touring Pack) is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 700cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
